episodes.title: #SweetJustice Part 1
episodes.summary: When six ordinary girls meet and discover that they each have extraordinary powers, they decide to join forces to take on one of Metropolis's most sinister villains.

episodes.title: #SweetJustice Part 2
episodes.summary: Wonder Woman trains Supergirl, Bumblebee, Batgirl, Zatanna and Green Lantern to become life-saving superheroes as they teach her to be an everyday teen.

episodes.title: #SweetJustice Part 3
episodes.summary: When LexCorp robots threaten to demolish Sweet Justice, the girls fight to save the shop. A disobedient superteen receives an unexpected punishment.

episodes.title: #SweetJustice Part 4
episodes.summary: The super squad schemes to stop Diana from returning home. In Metropolis, a war breaks out between LexCorp robots and the band of newly minted heroes.

episodes.title: #AdventuresInBunnysitting
episodes.summary: Zatanna asks Supergirl to look after her two magical bunnies, which quickly start to multiply, wreaking havoc all across Metropolis.

episodes.title: #HateTriangle
episodes.summary: When Hal Jordan's ex-girlfriend shows up at the Metropolis High homecoming game and goes love-ballistic as the villain Star Sapphire, Jessica Cruz begins to second-guess her own nonviolent tactics.

episodes.title: #BurritoBucket
episodes.summary: Batgirl loves her job at a fast food restaurant, but her boss would love any excuse to fire her. When a bank robbery breaks out across the street from work, Batgirl is torn between her role as a superhero and dutiful Burrito Bucket employee.

episodes.title: #MeetTheCheetah
episodes.summary: The Cheetah is super-jealous of "little Miss Perfect" Wonder Woman. But when she uses an ancient artifact from her father's collection to place a curse on Wonder Woman, it turns out that Wonder Woman is not the one who is cursed. It's the Cheetah!

episodes.title: #Beeline
episodes.summary: When she stumbles across a villainous plot to blow up a bridge, Bumblebee shies from the challenge of taking on the baddies and reaches out to her friends.

episodes.title: #SuperWho?
episodes.summary: Overwhelmed by the amount of Superman coverage in Metropolis, Supergirl decides to get out there and really show the city what she can do.

episodes.title: #ShockItToMe
episodes.summary: Leslie Willis, the meanest girl in school, becomes a social media sensation by posting mean-spirited videos on her MetropoVids channel, causing Wonder Woman to question the moral integrity of the people who live in the World of Man.

episodes.title: #SheMightBeGiant
episodes.summary: Karen Beecher is always getting picked on at school, but when the local mall is attacked by a monstrous supervillain called Giganta, she discovers that tiny Bumblebee might be the only one small enough to save the day.

episodes.title: #FightAtTheMuseum
episodes.summary: Supergirl always relies on her strength, but she'll need more than brawn to stop brainy Catwoman from stealing valuable gems from the local science museum.

episodes.title: #FromBatToWorse
episodes.summary: Having just moved to the boring Metropolis suburbs, Barbara Gordon is thrilled when she intercepts a call from Batman asking for help. But before she can stop a visiting Gotham villain, she'll have to sneak past her father, Commissioner Jim Gordon.

episodes.title: #CrushingIt
episodes.summary: Diana Prince is absolutely crushing it in every single aspect of life as a student at Metropolis High, until someone shows up who threatens to throw her off her game for good.

episodes.title: #MisgivingTree
episodes.summary: Jessica Cruz and Pamela Isley bond over protecting an ancient tree from being cut down. Neither of them realizes who the other's alter ego is, or the lengths to which they'll go to protect what's important.

episodes.title: #IllusionsOfGrandeur
episodes.summary: Ready to emerge from her father's shadow, Zee Zatara seeks fame and acclaim performing for audiences at the pier, and when her act is dismissed as fakery, she gets mad and accidentally unleashes gremlins who run wild all over the pier.

episodes.title: #BeastsInShow
episodes.summary: When Barbara Gordon and Kara Danver spar over whose dog is better, they decide to settle it at the Metropolis Dog Show, where Ace the Bat-Hound and Krypto the Superdog suddenly find themselves called upon to save the day... in more ways than one.

episodes.title: #GothamCon
episodes.summary: A fun day for Barbara Gordon and her bestie Harleen Quinzel at Gotham City's annual geekfest is turned on its head when the villainous Harley Quinn shows up to wreak havoc! Lucky for everyone, Batgirl just happens to be in the area...

episodes.title: #DCSuperHeroBoys Part 1
episodes.summary: What begins as a simple vandalism investigation becomes an all-out turf war when the team encounters a powerful trio of Kryptonians bent on world domination, and, perhaps even worse, a rival team of SUPER HERO BOYS!

episodes.title: #DCSuperHeroBoys Part 2
episodes.summary: What begins as a simple vandalism investigation becomes an all-out turf war when the team encounters a powerful trio of Kryptonians bent on world domination, and, perhaps even worse, a rival team of SUPER HERO BOYS!

episodes.title: #Frenemies Part 1
episodes.summary: Batgirl's worlds collide when her best friend from Gotham City moves to Metropolis. Meanwhile, Catwoman is making some new friends of her own.

episodes.title: #Frenemies Part 2
episodes.summary: Batgirl's worlds collide when her best friend from Gotham moves to Metropolis. Meanwhile, Catwoman is making some new friends of her own in this two-part special.

episodes.title: #SoulSisters Part 1
episodes.summary: The girls must track down Katana, a mysterious warrior who's stealing the souls of Metropolis's villains. Meanwhile, Diana's new friend Tatsu is a perfect match for her in every way, but may have a connection to Katana.

episodes.title: #SoulSisters Part 2
episodes.summary: The girls must track down Katana, a mysterious warrior who's stealing the souls of Metropolis's villains. Meanwhile, Diana's new friend Tatsu is a perfect match for her in every way, but may have a connection to Katana.

episodes.title: #Abracadabrapalooza
episodes.summary: In an attempt to make Karen feel better about a pimple, Zee recounts her embarrassing transition into magichood – and the rift it created between her and her father.

episodes.title: #RageCat
episodes.summary: Jessica Cruz is convinced she can find the purr-fect forever home for Dexter, a cat who has been deemed unadoptable because he's basically the worst cat in the world. Her overbearing persistence in trying to get him adopted leads Dexter to become Dex-Starr, a member of the Red Lantern Corps! Can Jess still find the good in a fuzzy little nemesis who is trying to kill her?

episodes.title: #TheGoodTheBadAndTheBizarre
episodes.summary: Everything is going well for Kara Danvers, both as a teen and a superhero, until she starts taking the blame for things she didn't do, and the emergence of a new supervillain threatens to destroy Supergirl's hard-earned reputation.

episodes.title: #BackInAFlash
episodes.summary: After an embarrassing incident ruins Barbara Gordon's reputation, rather than owning it and moving on, she decides it's easier to harness The Flash's newly discovered ability to travel back in time and alter the space-time continuum.

episodes.title: #PowerSurge
episodes.summary: When Supergirl is presumed dead after a battle with Livewire, Kara Danvers decides to reinvent herself with a new look, a new personality, and a new name, Power Girl.

episodes.title: #ScrambledEggs
episodes.summary: Thanks to a home economics assignment, the students are paired up and given an egg to "care for" over a weekend. But when tragedy befalls egg after egg, what should be an easy assignment escalates into a madcap romp with super-high stakes!.

episodes.title: #DramaQueen
episodes.summary: Oliver Queen must face off against his greatest rival yet, Mortimer Drake, while Green Arrow also finds himself up against a new foe, The Cavalier.

episodes.title: #AllyCat Part 1
episodes.summary: When Zee Zatara realizes Lex Luthor has unearthed a magical book with the power to tell the future, the girls reluctantly enlist Catwoman to help them steal it from him before he understands what he has, but it may already be too late.

episodes.title: #AllyCat Part 2
episodes.summary: When Zee Zatara realizes Lex Luthor has unearthed a magical book with the power to tell the future, the girls reluctantly enlist Catwoman to help them steal it from him before he understands what he has, but it may already be too late.

episodes.title: #Retreat!
episodes.summary: Jessica Cruz and some super friends go on an overnight camping trip without their powers and are attacked by Poison Ivy and a horde of Plant Zombies!

episodes.title: #DinnerForFive
episodes.summary: Barbara Gordon finds herself in a tight spot when an awkward dinner with a new friend's father turns into something so much more.

episodes.title: #LivingTheNightmare
episodes.summary: When Zee's friends are held captive in their nightmares by a dream demon, she'll have to confront her own hidden insecurities, or risk the Super Hero Girls being trapped in a prison of their own fears forever.

episodes.title: #AllAboutZee
episodes.summary: Zee Zatara is flattered when she meets an overeager admirer named Casey Krinsky, but soon realizes that "her biggest fan" wants much more than just an autograph.

episodes.title: #TweenTitans
episodes.summary: Jessica Cruz is hired by billionaire Bruce Wayne to chaperone young Dick Grayson's Metropolis birthday bash and brings Karen Beecher along to help; the girls get more than they bargained for when the party guests reveal their titanic personalities.

episodes.title: #EmperorPenguin
episodes.summary: When Barbara Gordon attempts to do something nice for a friend, she ends up in the clutches of The Penguin, a high school mob boss who blackmails her into an increasingly desperate situation from which only Batgirl can save her.

episodes.title: #BreakingNews
episodes.summary: Lois Lane's attempt to get an internship at the Daily Planet leads to her trying to unmask the Super Hero Girls, which forces the girls to a battle of wits with their greatest nemesis yet.

episodes.title: #CrashCourse
episodes.summary: When a high-speed chase breaks out during her driver's test, Diana Prince's desire to fight evil clashes with her desire to undergo a World of Man teenage rite of passage, getting her license.

episodes.title: #LeagueOfShadows Part 1
episodes.summary: Under the control of Red Kryptonite, Kara Danvers is brainwashed by rock 'n roll front man Ra's al Ghul and sent on a mission to purify the world... starting with the terrible music of Karen Beecher's favorite boy band!

episodes.title: #LeagueOfShadows Part 2
episodes.summary: Under the control of Red Kryptonite, Kara Danvers is brainwashed by rock 'n' roll front man Ra's al Ghul and sent on a mission to purify the world.

episodes.title: #HousePest
episodes.summary: When the Super Hero Girls discover that Diana doesn't actually have a home, they gladly open theirs up to her. That is, until they discover that life with an Amazon is much more challenging than they expected.

episodes.title: #ItsComplicated
episodes.summary: When Hal Jordan sees Carol Ferris with a new boyfriend, his ego can't handle the rejection, resulting in the most absurd Lantern battle ever.

episodes.title: #TheBirdAndTheBee
episodes.summary: Meek little Karen Beecher is intimidated by big broody Carter Hall until she discovers Hawkman's tragically romantic destiny and vows to use her vast knowledge of cheesy teen movies to help him reunite with his beloved.

episodes.title: #FantasticBeastsAndHowToMindThem
episodes.summary: Diana Prince receives a care package from home, and her pet-raising skills are soon put to the test when a mysterious egg hatches into a baby griffin.

episodes.title: #SchoolGhoul
episodes.summary: When Tatsu Yamashiro asks for help at a haunted all-girls academy, Barbara Gordon and Kara Danvers find themselves caught up in something much bigger than a ghost hunt.

episodes.title: #AwesomeAuntAntiope
episodes.summary: Diana always preferred her "fun aunt" Antiope to her strict mother, but when Antiope visits Metropolis and takes the girls out on the town, Diana sees her aunt's antics in a whole new light.

episodes.title: #TheFreshPrincessOfRenFaire Part 1
episodes.summary: A fun day at the Renaissance Faire takes a dark turn when our heroes clash with a princess-eating dragon.

episodes.title: #TheFreshPrincessOfRenFaire Part 2
episodes.summary: A shapeshifting dragon named Ember wants to eat Princess Diana.

episodes.title: #AmBatgirl Part 1
episodes.summary: Batgirl finally has the chance to live out her life's dream and be the sidekick to her hero and inspiration—the Batman!

episodes.title: #AmBatgirl Part 2
episodes.summary: Batgirl finally has the chance to live out her life's dream and be the sidekick to her hero and inspiration—the Batman!

episodes.title: #DoubleDanvers
episodes.summary: When Kara realizes that she needs to be in two places on the same night, a dinner with an important investor in her parents' startup and a concert for her favorite band, the Malevolent Maniaxe at the Lazarus Pit, she calls for reinforcements in the form of Bizarro Kara!

episodes.title: #AccordingToGarth
episodes.summary: Garth meets a friend who shares his obsession with a particular fandom. But when that friend takes his obsession too far, Garth must learn the difference between being a fan and being a fanatic, or risk driving his friends away.

episodes.title: #SuperWonderBatBeeZeeLanterMobile
episodes.summary: The Super Hero Girls decide to go in together to buy their first car, but quickly learn that splitting an automobile six ways may prove to be their deadliest foe yet!

episodes.title: #SirensConch
episodes.summary: Diana is asked to sing in a talent show, but when she uses a magical artifact to hide how bad she is at singing, she unleashes mayhem onto Metropolis.

episodes.title: #AngerManagement
episodes.summary: When Jess coerces Kara into addressing her anger management issues, Supergirl's superhero abilities become seriously compromised!.

episodes.title: #HappyBirthdayZee
episodes.summary: Zatanna makes a birthday wish that forces her to confront the dark side of her magic.

episodes.title: #TheGreenRoom
episodes.summary: When Jessica is faced with a Green Lantern Corps disciplinary hearing, Hal appoints himself to be her Peer Advocate.

episodes.title: #EnterNightSting
episodes.summary: Karen is given a mission to prevent the apocalypse by DeathSting, a super-cool future version of herself.

episodes.title: #WorldsFinest
episodes.summary: When PR whiz Max Lord tells Batgirl and Supergirl he can improve their image by doing publicity stunts, the two friends forget what being a hero is really about.

episodes.title: #WorkingStiff
episodes.summary: After Babs hooks Karen up with a job at the Burrito Bucket, the two heroes encounter a new villain, the scourge of the fast-food underworld, the Condiment King!.

episodes.title: #MultipliciZee
episodes.summary: Zee magically duplicates herself so she can shirk work and watch TV. Things get out of hand when her copies start to make copies of themselves!.

episodes.title: #TheMinus
episodes.summary: Diana receives her first ever A-minus and becomes convinced that she needs to work harder, however, in order to do so, she resorts to rather drastic measures.

episodes.title: #Powerless
episodes.summary: Supergirl loses her powers and, with the help of BumbleBee, must rely on her street smarts to save Garth from vengeful Toyman.

episodes.title: #AcceptNoSubstitute
episodes.summary: Feeling smothered, Babs urges her retired dad, Commissioner Gordon, to get a hobby, but her advice backfires when the Commissioner becomes a substitute teacher at her school!.

episodes.title: #WarriorAndTheJester
episodes.summary: After accidentally destroying one of Babs' beloved, one-of-a-kind Batman keepsakes, Diana enlists the help of Harleen Quinzel in order to find a replacement in Gotham City.

episodes.title: #MotherKnowsBest
episodes.summary: Hippolyta visits town and Diana is desperate to win her approval. But when Hippolyta unexpectedly takes a shine to Kara, Diana must curb her envy before they all get hurt.

episodes.title: #DetentionClub
episodes.summary: Five socially disparate teens, Hal, Pam, Kara, Zee and Garth, find they have more in common than they thought after spending a Saturday in detention.

episodes.title: #SmallVictories
episodes.summary: A malfunctioning device shrinks Karen into the Microverse, leaving technophobic Diana as her only hope.

episodes.title: #CruzControl
episodes.summary: Working toward her dream of making her school a better place, Jessica runs for class president. However, when her opponent, the corrupt Oswald Cobblepot, pulls ahead in the race using less-than-honest means, Jessica finds herself compromising the integrity of her honest campaign to beat him!.

episodes.title: #WhySoBlue
episodes.summary: Supergirl must rein in a reckless new hero, the Blue Beetle.

episodes.title: #OneEnchantedEvening
episodes.summary: Zee worries that Zatara is lonely and volunteers to play matchmaker for her dad. But when her meddlesome match-matching accidentally sets her dad up with an old enemy, Zee must find a way to fix the mess she made!.

episodes.title: #TheAquamanCometh
episodes.summary: For months, Garth's been sending Aquaman letters that greatly exaggerate his accomplishments in Metropolis, so when the King of Atlantis comes for a surprise visit, Garth begs the Super Hero Girls to help cover for his little white lies.

episodes.title: #NightmareInGotham Part 1
episodes.summary: Babs and Harleen bring the Girls to Gotham City to celebrate Halloween! However, the fun is put on hold when the SuperHero Girls run into Gotham's most notorious SuperVillain.

episodes.title: #NightmareInGotham Part 2
episodes.summary: Babs and Harleen bring the Girls to Gotham City to celebrate Halloween! However, the fun is put on hold when the SuperHero Girls run into Gotham's most notorious SuperVillain.
